The 2024 Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show is just around the corner. It will take place from October 30 to November 3 in the heart of Fort Lauderdale, Florida, the “Yachting Capital of the World.” This year marks the 65th annual edition of the world’s largest in-water boat show, featuring various boats, yachts, and marine products across seven incredible locations.

We are excited to be part of this prestigious event with our exclusive distributors, NHD Boats and OKEAN Yachts. We invite you to visit OKEAN Yachts at the Bahia Mar Yachting Center, where they will unveil their newest models and showcase their open-side deck design and performance. Meanwhile, NHD Boats will be located at the Broward County Convention Center, offering a closer look at their latest innovations and craftsmanship with The OPEN DECK system.

Whether you’re a seasoned yachting enthusiast or just getting into the boating lifestyle, this is the perfect opportunity to explore what’s new and exciting in the world of luxury yachts. Join us at the show, see the latest models, and learn more about these incredible brands. We can’t wait to welcome you!

FLIBS Information & Tickets



Now that you know we are part of one of the world’s largest in-water boat shows, don’t miss the chance to connect with our team for a personalized VIP experience at FLIBS. Contact us to schedule an appointment, and we’ll ensure you meet with one of our expert yacht representatives.

Let our professional team serve as your personal guide throughout the show. We’ll introduce you to the latest offerings from NHD Boats and OKEAN Yachts, as well as any other models you’re interested in. Experience the Fort Lauderdale International Boat Show in a way only our team can offer, with dedicated service and insider access.
